name: ReflectLog Memory
description: Replaces OpenClaw's built-in memory with the ReflectLog MCP server: hybrid semantic + full-text recall, audience-partitioned workspaces, and pre-compaction flush through ReflectLog.

cliCommands.name: reflectlog
cliCommands.description: Inspect, search, export, and import ReflectLog-backed memory

transport.label: Transport
transport.help: How to reach ReflectLog; streamable HTTP is the only supported transport

url.label: ReflectLog MCP URL
url.help: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a ReflectLog server started with --transport http

authTokenEnv.label: Token environment variable
authTokenEnv.help: Environment variable that holds the ReflectLog REFLECTLOG_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN bearer token; the token itself never goes in config

namespace.label: Deployment namespace
namespace.help: Separates the ReflectLog workspaces of different OpenClaw deployments sharing one server

workspaceOverrides.label: Owner workspace overrides
workspaceOverrides.help: Map an agent id to an existing ReflectLog workspace for its owner-private memory

defaultMaxResults.label: Default results
defaultMaxResults.help: Hits returned by memory search when the caller does not ask for a count (1-50)

smartReplace.label: Smart replacement
smartReplace.help: Let memory_store(replace=true) ask ReflectLog to replace contradicted memories; flush and import always add only
